findings.summary: For capabilities, the disk test only compares a file with itself, so it does not pin the id-to-path convention.
findings.evidence: For the capability texts, the plan uses the include_str! paths already at lib.rs:655-658, which read the same crates/athena-cap-*/prompts/*.md files the test then reads from disk. athena-context cannot depend on athena-cap-change or athena-cap-study (crate reach: cap-* depend on context). So the test never checks that the PromptAsset with id capability.change.verifier is built from crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md. It only checks that the file exists. The frame half is sound, because lib.rs's own consts carry both the id and the text. Fix: Add the capability half of the check in athena-cli, which depends on cap-change and cap-study and has context as a dev crate. In crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs, for each real capability's producer_section() and verifier_section(), read prompt_file_path(section.id) from the repository root and assert it equals section.text. Keep the lib.rs test for the contract and the frames.

findings.summary: The plan does not mention D141, the earlier fix for this same failure class, or why that fix was not enough.
findings.evidence: docs/decisions.md:3693-3714 (D141) already added the per-set 'Prompt token headroom' section for this class (bm4c), citing the same jobs 1as8, vava and wqp8. Its tradeoff line reads 'A reading can still ignore the numbers.' CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line 20 says Hestia now queues a cause again when it recurs after its fix has landed, which is how this request arose. The plan's root cause is in effect 'D141 gave sets, not files', but it never says so. Fix: In the CHANGELOG bullet and in D185, say that this follows D141. State that the per-set rows were already present and that the gap closed now is matching a file to its sets and taking the tightest room.
findings.location: Plan approach and step 6 (CHANGELOG entry and D185)

findings.summary: Nothing checks that the failures after D141 came from mapping ids to files. Some of them may be producer-side.
findings.evidence: Introspections fka0 (job r4pj), a1y0 (h9ea) and m8x3 (jj8g) propose post-producer checks that old prompt rules are still present after an edit. That points to a producer dropping rules to fit the budget, a failure this brief change does not address. records/ is not in the snapshot, so the plan cannot have read whether those readings had the per-set table and still misjudged the room. The plan already says it does not measure whether readers act on the table. Fix: In D185's Provenance, say plainly that the link between the later failures and id-to-file mapping is inferred, not read from records. Name the post-producer rule-preservation failure as a separate follow-up and leave it unaddressed here. No code change is needed.

findings.summary: The new athena-core test assumes the scripted run never consults the 'change' capability beyond the brief.
findings.evidence: run_pin_tests.rs:250 builds capabilities as vec![Box::new(PinningStudy)], and the scripted reply picks 'study' (:170). With StandInChange pushed, the catalog in the reader set now holds two cards. The test asserts nothing about the catalog, so this is harmless, but nothing else in ask has been checked for whether it iterates every capability. Fix: No change needed. If ask fails in the new test, check whether any code there iterates every capability.

summary: I checked the plan against the code by reading it. The places it names all exist where it says. HeadroomRow, left() and headroom_rows are at lib.rs:238-312, the component ids at lib.rs:33-67, headroom_section at reader.rs:641-661, reader_headroom at reading.rs:258-280 and the existing tests at briefs.rs:3913, 4263 and 4588 and run_pin_tests.rs:1582-1646. The capability ids and include_str! paths are at cap-change lib.rs:19-26 and cap-study lib.rs:24-31. The fix goes where the reader gets its figures. It builds the per-file table from the same rows, so it cannot drift from the per-set lines or the budgets test. It adds no refusal rule, which suits the request's preference for giving the stage more information. Every behavior demonstration names a real seam: file_headroom, reader_brief, or Athena::ask through read_once. Each would fail without the change and checks the minimum across sets, not one instance. The athena-core test's stand-in capability doubles only prompt ids and text, and the test computes the expected room itself. The test name filters match the new test names. The dependents list covers every reader I found by grep: briefs.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, reading.rs, budgets.rs, refusal_corpus and buy_first. I found no blocker or major problem. There are three minor findings. First, the disk test's capability half is circular: athena-context compares each capability file with include_str! of that same file, so it never ties capability.change.verifier to that file. Second, the plan does not mention D141, the earlier fix for this class. Third, the claim that the failures that came after D141 were caused by matching ids to files is an untested assumption, and some later introspections point to a different, producer-side failure.
